sources.title: On Core Stability, Vital Coalitions, and Extendability
sources.finding: Exact game min of disjoint-support vectors (2,1,1,0,0,0) and (0,0,0,2,1,1) has entire core their segment. Cites Rosenmüller2000 for core equality and Raghavan–Sudhölter2005 for exactness. No asymptotic selector separation.

sources.title: Linear criterion for testing the extremity of an exact game based on its finest min-representation
sources.classification: exact prior representation theorem; known method specialization
sources.finding: Exact iff core-based finite min representation. Regular min representation means generators are among core vertices, not necessarily all. Does not make arbitrary generator hull equal core.

sources.title: Facets of the cone of exact games

sources.finding: No examined statement directly gives proposed selector coefficient. Not a finite-hull identity license.

sources.title: A contribution to the connections between Fibonacci Numbers and Matrix Theory
sources.classification: adjacent known Fibonacci matrix method; not direct implication
sources.finding: Bounds inverse-entry sums of triangular binary matrices by Fibonacci numbers. Their unimodular/integral setting alone cannot supply positive A^-1*1 with arbitrarily small positive coordinate.
